boundary: Post-review diagnostic on the already observed accepted-snapshot evaluation period; not a new holdout or confirmatory validation.

arms.firm_conditioned_qa_raw: mean_firms(d), original signed raw baseline, PCA32
arms.firm_conditioned_qa_direction: mean_firms(d/||d||), original signed unit baseline, PCA32
arms.unsigned_raw: mean_firms(abs(d)), element-wise absolute value BEFORE sector averaging, PCA32
arms.unsigned_unit: mean_firms(abs(d/||d||)), element-wise absolute value BEFORE sector averaging, PCA32
arms.raw_pca1: mean_firms(d), same raw features but PCA1 as dimensionality diagnostic

features.basis: fixed pinned SEC-BERT embedding coordinates; no rotation before absolute value
features.reference: strictly prior expanding issuer mean, at least two prior months
features.sector_aggregation: arithmetic firm mean, no sector renormalization

ensemble: Mean of within-month average percentile prediction ranks at 128,160,200 words

evaluation.ic: Spearman cross-sectional correlation; arithmetic mean across eligible months

inference.NW_reference: statsmodels OLS constant, HAC, use_correction=False, normal p-values

shift.method: nonzero sector-wise circular shifts across all observed score months, exactly original sector order and RNG draw order

inference.multiplicity: unadjusted diagnostic p-values; all prespecified arms and contrasts retained

baseline_sanity: Raw/unit fitted ensemble predictions must match archived scores within 1e-12 and monthly IC exactly

public_replay_boundary.inputs: sector-level scores and targets, aggregate monthly IC and null paths
